title: ID0445870-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / S7 170003822] Input Meter not configured; only pre-control active
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
We have no AC meter on this charger and since I updated to fw8 I get this active error flag. We have one G4 converter but this only because we had a faulty converter and at that time the G2 was cheaper then G2. It is possible to make the ReactivePowerControl an option you need to activate in SCB configuartion like ELMS?
Root cause:
adjustments to FW
Solution: R&D to provide a solution
